caption:
Swim, bike, run, repeat. Toto's whole body feels tight, but where does massage actually fit?

Each discipline loads something different: shoulders and upper back from the pool, quads, hip flexors and neck from the bike, calves and feet from running. Firmer remedial massage often suits early in a recovery week, with lighter sessions close to race day. A first-ever deep session right before an event isn't ideal.

Massage is a support act. Strength work, sleep, fuelling and sensible load progressions do most of the work. Sharp, localised or worsening pain is worth a physio assessment instead.

Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can tailor sessions to your training. Book online via the link in bio.
